cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && set -o pipefail && test -f bench/results/environment-narration/enforce-stage1/smoke/rows/rows.json && test -f bench/results/environment-narration/enforce-stage1/smoke/rows/summary.json && test -f bench/results/environment-narration/enforce-stage1/smoke/spent.json && .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
base='bench/results/environment-narration/enforce-stage1/smoke'
rows=json.load(open(base+'/rows/rows.json'))
summary=json.load(open(base+'/rows/summary.json'))
assert summary['enforce'] is True, 'enforce not on'
assert summary.get('shadow', False) is False, 'shadow on'
spent=json.load(open(base+'/spent.json'))
assert spent['spent_micro_usd'] <= 30000, 'cap exceeded'
for row in rows:
    for turn in row.get('turns', []):
        assert 'turn_elapsed_s' in turn
        assert 'enforce_attempts' in turn
        assert 'narration_attempts' in turn
if summary.get('stopped_reason') is None:
    assert len(rows) == 1, 'unexpected replicate count'
    assert all(len(row.get('turns', [])) == 9 for row in rows), 'incomplete route'
    for row in rows:
        assert row['turns'][7]['input'] == 'pick up my laptop', 'wrong eighth command'
        assert row['turns'][-1]['input'] == 'inspect the passenger seat', 'wrong final command'
print('replicates',len(rows),'turns',sum(len(r.get('turns',[])) for r in rows),'stopped',summary.get('stopped_reason'))
print('spent',spent)
PY
(set -a; . ./.env; set +a; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os
base='bench/results/environment-narration/enforce-stage1/smoke'
text=''.join(open(os.path.join(directory, filename)).read() for directory, _, filenames in os.walk(base) for filename in filenames)
for name in ('CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN','CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID','CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN'):
    value=os.environ.get(name,'').strip()
    assert not value or value not in text, name+' value leaked into outputs'
print('no credential in outputs')
PY
)
